parsed.internal_thinking: Charlie ended his turn. He's sitting on 3 Wood and 1 Brick. Alice is still holding her 2 Sheep and 2 Wood. Nobody wants to trade with me because of the last game, but I also didn't need Charlie's wood. I need to keep an eye on Charlie's expansion toward that Brick port; if he gets it, he'll be a problem. My next move depends on the dice giving me something other than wood.
parsed.note_to_self: Charlie has 3 Wood and 1 Brick. Alice has 2 Wood, 1 Brick, and 2 Sheep. Both are shunning me. I need a 6 or 10 to get materials, or a 5 to get my brick production back if the robber moves.
